info.description:
Ingest generic events to OpenPipeline configurations for different data sources.

To read about use cases and examples, see [Dynatrace Documentation](https://dt-url.net/openpipeline-pipelines-docs).

To authorize, use a valid access token or personal access token. Make sure the access token has the openpipeline.events scope.

Notes about compatibility:
* Operations marked as early adopter or preview may be changed in non-compatible ways, although we try to avoid this.
* We may add new enum constants without incrementing the API version; thus, clients need to handle unknown enum constants gracefully.

post.description:
The maximum payload size of a single request is **10 MiB**. Requests with a greater payload are rejected, and the API returns a 413 response code.
**Query Parameters** Each request query parameter becomes a top-level record attribute. In case there is already an attribute in the payload with the same name as the query parameter, the original value will be overridden. Every time a field is overridden, the original value is preserved in a field named `overwritten.`
**Timestamp field** If there is no `timestamp` field in the request payload, the current server time is used as timestamp. If the `timestamp` field is present and it has a **numeric** value, the time unit is assumed based on the size of the value. Nano seconds by default. Afterwards, the field will be converted to a `Timestamp` type in nano seconds. If the `timestamp` field is present and has a string value, attempts are made to parse it based on UNIX epoch milliseconds or seconds, RFC3339 or RFC3164 format, in this order. If the `timestamp` has the wrong type (e.g. boolean, array) or cannot be properly parsed, it is overridden with the current server time and the original value is preserved. **Custom endpoints** Custom endpoints need to be defined first via the OpenPipeline Configuration API or the OpenPipeline app, see [Dynatrace Documentation](https://dt-url.net/openpipeline-pipelines-docs).

post.summary: Security Events Ingest default endpoint for the security.events table | maturity=EARLY_ADOPTER

post.description:
The maximum payload size of a single request is **10 MiB**. Requests with a greater payload are rejected, and the API returns a 413 response code.
**Timestamp field** If there is no `timestamp` field in the request payload, the current server time is used as timestamp. If the `timestamp` field is present and it has a **numeric** value, the time unit is assumed based on the size of the value. Nano seconds by default. Afterwards, the field will be converted to a `Timestamp` type in nano seconds. If the `timestamp` field is present and has a string value, attempts are made to parse it based on UNIX epoch milliseconds or seconds, RFC3339 or RFC3164 format, in this order. If the `timestamp` has the wrong type (e.g. boolean, array) or cannot be properly parsed, it is overridden with the current server time and the original value is preserved.
**Smartscape event validation** Each event must identify an entity using exactly one of two modes: - **Mode 1** — supply a pre-computed `id` matching `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[0-9A-F]{16}` (e.g. `HOST-0000000000000001`). - **Mode 2** — supply `type` (matching `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*`) and `id_components` (a non-empty array of single-key objects whose values are strings). The two modes are mutually exclusive. - Structural keys (`type`, `id`, `id_components`, `dt.security_context`, `update_lifetime`, `timestamp`, `static_edges`, `dynamic_edges`, `event.version`) are reserved. - For core entity types (not `EXT_*` / `CUSTOM_*`), only `name`, `process.metadata[COMMAND_LINE_ARGS]`, and names starting with `ext.` or `custom.` are allowed. - Extended entity types (`EXT_*` / `CUSTOM_*`) bypass the allowlist (structural keys still reserved). - Field values must be scalar (string, number, boolean, or null) or a flat `string:string` object (both keys and values must be strings). **Tags** — tag contexts are top-level keys with a `tags:` prefix: - E.g. `"tags:ext.source": { "env": "production" }` defines a tag context `ext.source`. - For core entity types, context names (after stripping `tags:`) must start with `ext.` or `custom.`. - Extended entity types bypass this restriction. - Tag property values must be scalar (string, number, boolean, or null). **Schema versioning** — the optional `event.version` field (integer) declares which version of the smartscape event format your producer targets. Supplying it is strongly recommended: it guarantees a **stable interface** — if the format evolves under a new version, your events keep being processed exactly as before. Currently only version `1` is supported; unsupported values are rejected with a `400` response. Invalid events are rejected with a `400` response listing every offending field.

requestBody.description: The JSON body of the request. Contains the events for ingest.

202.description: Accepted. Response doesn't have a body.

AnyValue.description: A schema representing an arbitrary value type.

ErrorResponse.description: Basic information of the encountered error.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the error, if available.

type.description:
Defines the actual set of fields depending on the value. See one of the following objects: 

* `constraintViolation` -> ConstraintViolationDetails

EventList.description: A top-level array of event objects.

Events.description: The events to be ingested. The request body can either be a single event object or a top-level array of event objects.

SmartscapeEdge.description: A reference to a related Smartscape node used to define a topology edge. Either `id` (Mode 1) or `type` + `id_components` (Mode 2) must be present. The two modes are mutually exclusive.

id.description: Pre-computed ID of the related node (**Mode 1**). Must match `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[0-9A-F]{16}`. Mutually exclusive with `type`.

id_components.description: Identity components of the related node (**Mode 2**). Required when `type` is set; optional in Mode 1. Each entry must be a single-key object whose value is a **string** (e.g. `[{"hostname": "myhost"}]`).

additionalProperties.description: Identity components of the related node (**Mode 2**). Required when `type` is set; optional in Mode 1. Each entry must be a single-key object whose value is a **string** (e.g. `[{"hostname": "myhost"}]`).

items.description: Identity components of the related node (**Mode 2**). Required when `type` is set; optional in Mode 1. Each entry must be a single-key object whose value is a **string** (e.g. `[{"hostname": "myhost"}]`).

type.description: Type of the related node (**Mode 2**). Must match `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*`. Mutually exclusive with `id`.

SmartscapeEvent.description:
A Smartscape node upsert event. Exactly one identity mode must be used: **Mode 1** supplies a pre-computed `id`; **Mode 2** supplies `type` + `id_components` and the server computes the ID. The two modes are mutually exclusive — supplying both `id` and `type` is rejected.

fields and tag contexts are top-level keys. Tag contexts use a `tags:` prefix (e.g. `tags:ext.source`).

dt.security_context.description: Security context. String or array of strings.

additionalProperties.description: Dynamic topology edges, keyed by relationship name. Each value is an array of target node references.

dynamic_edges.description: Dynamic topology edges, keyed by relationship name. Each value is an array of target node references.

event.version.description: Schema version of this event. Optional — version 1 is applied when absent. Must be a known version; currently only 1 is accepted.

id.description: Pre-computed Smartscape entity ID (**Mode 1**). Must match `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*-[0-9A-F]{16}` (e.g. `HOST-0000000000000001`). Mutually exclusive with `type`.

id_components.description: Identity components used to compute the entity ID (**Mode 2**). Required when `type` is set; optional in Mode 1. Each entry must be a single-key object whose value is a **string** (e.g. `[{"hostname": "myhost"}]`).

additionalProperties.description: Identity components used to compute the entity ID (**Mode 2**). Required when `type` is set; optional in Mode 1. Each entry must be a single-key object whose value is a **string** (e.g. `[{"hostname": "myhost"}]`).

items.description: Identity components used to compute the entity ID (**Mode 2**). Required when `type` is set; optional in Mode 1. Each entry must be a single-key object whose value is a **string** (e.g. `[{"hostname": "myhost"}]`).

additionalProperties.description: Static topology edges, keyed by relationship name. Each value is an array of target node references.

static_edges.description: Static topology edges, keyed by relationship name. Each value is an array of target node references.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp. Optional — current server time is used when absent. Accepted formats: RFC3339 string (e.g. `2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`) or a positive number. Zero and negative numbers are rejected.

type.description: Entity type (**Mode 2**). Must match `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*` (e.g. `HOST`, `HOST_GROUP`). Mutually exclusive with `id`. Types starting with `EXT_` or `CUSTOM_` are treated as extended entity types and bypass the field-name allowlist.

update_lifetime.description: Whether to advance the entity's last-seen timestamp. Defaults to true. Set to false to update fields without refreshing the last-seen time.

SmartscapeEventList.description: A top-level array of Smartscape event objects.

SmartscapeEvents.description: The Smartscape events to be ingested. The request body can either be a single Smartscape event object or a top-level array of Smartscape event objects.

Api-Token.description:
Dynatrace API Token

 The token is passed in the **Authorization** header in the following format: `Authorization: Api-Token abcdefjhij1234567890`.
Api-Token.name: Authorization

ssoAuth.description:
Dynatrace OAuth

 A Bearer token is passed in the **Authorization** header in the following format: `Authorization: Bearer abcdefjhij1234567890`.

scopes.openpipeline:events.custom:ingest: Ingest events into custom endpoints of OpenPipeline
scopes.openpipeline:events.sdlc.custom:ingest: Ingest software development lifecycle events into custom endpoints of OpenPipeline
scopes.openpipeline:events.sdlc:ingest: Ingest software development lifecycle events into OpenPipeline
scopes.openpipeline:security.events.custom:inge: Ingest security events into custom endpoints of OpenPipeline

ssoBearerAuth.description:
The value can be either an OAuth2 access token or a platform token.
